title: The Shawshank Redemption
tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
overview: A banker sentenced to life for a crime he swears he didn't commit spends two decades inside a brutal prison, quietly building an unlikely friendship and an even more unlikely plan.

title: The Godfather
tagline: An offer you can't refuse.
overview: The aging head of a New York crime family tries to hand his empire to a reluctant son, who is pulled deeper into the family business than he ever intended.

title: The Dark Knight
tagline: Why so serious?
overview: Gotham's masked vigilante faces a chaos-loving criminal who wants to prove that anyone, even the city's brightest hero, can be pushed to the edge.

title: Pulp Fiction
tagline: Just because you are a character doesn't mean you have character.
overview: Two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers collide in a playful, out-of-order tangle of Los Angeles crime stories.

title: Inception
tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
overview: A thief who steals secrets from inside dreams is offered one last job: instead of taking an idea, he has to plant one, layers deep in a target's subconscious.

title: Interstellar
tagline: Mankind was born on Earth. It was never meant to die here.
overview: With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot leaves his family to lead a desperate voyage through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity.

title: Parasite
tagline: Act like you own the place.
overview: A struggling family cons its way, one job at a time, into the household of a wealthy couple, until a secret beneath the house upends everything.

title: Spirited Away
tagline: Nothing that happens is ever forgotten.
overview: On the way to a new home, a ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a magical bathhouse to free her parents from a witch's spell.

title: The Matrix
tagline: Reality is a thing of the past.
overview: A hacker learns that the world he knows is a simulation run by machines, and that he may be the one person able to break humanity free.

title: Fight Club
tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.
overview: An insomniac office worker and a charismatic soap salesman start an underground club that spirals into something far more dangerous.

title: Forrest Gump
tagline: The world will never be the same once you've seen it through the eyes of Forrest Gump.
overview: A kind-hearted man from Alabama drifts through decades of American history, always hoping to reunite with the girl he has loved since childhood.

title: Gladiator
tagline: A hero will rise.
overview: Betrayed and enslaved, a Roman general fights his way up through the arenas toward the emperor who murdered his family.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
tagline: One ring to rule them all.
overview: A quiet hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions on a perilous journey to destroy it.

title: Whiplash
tagline: The road to greatness can take you to the edge.
overview: An ambitious young jazz drummer is pushed to his physical and mental limits by a ferocious conservatory instructor.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
tagline: What a lovely day.
overview: In a scorched wasteland, a drifter and a rebel commander flee across the desert in a war rig, chased by a tyrant and his army of fanatics.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
tagline: More than one wears the mask.
overview: Brooklyn teen Miles Morales gains spider powers just as a collider tears open reality, bringing a crew of Spider-People from other dimensions.

title: Dune: Part Two
tagline: Long live the fighters.
overview: Paul Atreides unites with the desert people of Arrakis to wage war on the house that destroyed his family, while dreading the future he foresees.

title: Oppenheimer
tagline: The world forever changes.
overview: The story of the physicist who led the race to build the atomic bomb, and of the political storm that followed him afterwards.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
tagline: The universe is so much bigger than you realize.
overview: A laundromat owner buried in tax paperwork discovers she can tap into the lives of her alternate selves to stop a threat to every universe.

title: Get Out
tagline: Just because you're invited, doesn't mean you're welcome.
overview: A young man's weekend visit to his girlfriend's family estate turns from awkward to terrifying as he uncovers what they really want.

title: La La Land
tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.
overview: An aspiring actress and a jazz pianist fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing dreams that may pull them in different directions.

title: Blade Runner 2049
tagline: The key to the future is finally unearthed.
overview: A replicant hunter uncovers a long-buried secret that could plunge what's left of society into chaos, leading him to a missing legend.

title: Arrival
tagline: Why are they here?
overview: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, a linguist races to understand their language before fear tips the world into war.

title: Coco
tagline: The celebration of a lifetime.
overview: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician stumbles into the vibrant Land of the Dead and sets out to uncover his family's hidden history.

title: Joker
tagline: Put on a happy face.
overview: Ignored and mistreated by the city around him, a failed stand-up comedian slowly transforms into a symbol of chaos.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
tagline: A murder case. A missing painting. A family fortune.
overview: A legendary concierge and his loyal lobby boy are swept into a caper over a priceless painting and a contested inheritance.

title: Alien
tagline: In space no one can hear you scream.
overview: The crew of a commercial towing ship answers a distress call and brings back an unknown lifeform that begins hunting them one by one.

title: Back to the Future
tagline: He's the only kid ever to get into trouble before he was born.
overview: A teenager is accidentally sent thirty years into the past in a time-traveling car and must make sure his parents still fall in love.

title: Amélie
tagline: She'll change your life.
overview: A shy Parisian waitress decides to secretly improve the lives of the people around her, while dodging the chance to fix her own.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
tagline: Feel the need.
overview: Decades after his first tour, a veteran naval aviator returns to train a squad of young pilots for a nearly impossible mission.

title: Knives Out
tagline: Hell, any of them could have done it.
overview: When a wealthy crime novelist is found dead after his birthday party, an eccentric detective untangles the lies of his very suspicious family.

title: Your Name.
tagline: Somewhere, someone you've never met is waiting.
overview: A city boy and a country girl mysteriously begin swapping bodies, and set out to find each other before a looming comet changes everything.

title: Breaking Bad
creator: Vince Gilligan
tagline: Remember my name.
overview: A mild-mannered chemistry teacher with a terminal diagnosis teams up with a former student to cook meth, and slowly becomes someone else entirely.

title: Game of Thrones
creator: David Benioff & D. B. Weiss
tagline: Winter is coming.
overview: Noble houses scheme and battle for control of the Iron Throne while an ancient threat gathers beyond the great northern wall.

title: Stranger Things
creator: The Duffer Brothers
tagline: Every ending has a beginning.
overview: When a boy vanishes in a small Indiana town, his friends, family and a mysterious girl uncover secret experiments and a terrifying other world.

title: The Office
creator: Greg Daniels
tagline: A documentary crew. A paper company. Zero chill.
overview: A mockumentary following the everyday chaos of a mid-sized paper company branch and its painfully well-meaning manager.

title: Chernobyl
creator: Craig Mazin
tagline: What is the cost of lies?
overview: A gripping account of the 1986 nuclear disaster and the scientists, workers and officials who fought to contain it and uncover the truth.

title: The Last of Us
creator: Craig Mazin & Neil Druckmann
tagline: When you're lost in the darkness, look for the light.
overview: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak collapses civilization, a hardened smuggler escorts a teenage girl who may be humanity's last hope.

title: Succession
creator: Jesse Armstrong
tagline: Make your move.
overview: The four adult children of a ruthless media mogul jockey for control of the family empire as their father refuses to let go.

title: Dark
creator: Baran bo Odar & Jantje Friese
tagline: The question is not where, but when.
overview: A missing child in a small German town exposes the fractured relationships of four families and a time-travel conspiracy spanning generations.

title: The Bear
creator: Christopher Storer
tagline: Every second counts.
overview: A young fine-dining chef comes home to Chicago to run his late brother's chaotic sandwich shop and its stubborn, loyal crew.

title: Severance
creator: Dan Erickson
tagline: Work. Life. Separated.
overview: Employees of a secretive corporation undergo a procedure that splits their work memories from their personal lives, until the walls start to crack.

title: Arcane
creator: Christian Linke & Alex Yee
tagline: Every legend has a beginning.
overview: Two sisters are driven apart amid rising tensions between a gleaming utopian city and the oppressed undercity beneath it.

title: Sherlock
creator: Mark Gatiss & Steven Moffat
tagline: The game is on.
overview: A brilliant, abrasive consulting detective and an army doctor solve baffling crimes across modern-day London.
